name: Kelington Group Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为股息、股份拆细/额外上市及季度业绩，未披露各业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长22.1%，净利润同比增长25.7%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered dividends, share subdivision/additional listings and quarterly results, with no disclosed expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or contract wins for any business segment. Latest quarter (30 June 2026) revenue grew 22.1% year-on-year and net profit grew 25.7% year-on-year.
